system.enhancements: 360-Degree Vision, Access Jacks, Enhanced Vision, Laser Link
system.biography:
Sky motes are mini-sized aerostats designed to keep position over an area and act as a relay point for a mote mesh (see Motes, p. 154). They are typically deployed over areas where high terrain, bodies of water, or other environmental factors impede a mote network’s coverage or to link two distant mote networks together. Sky motes are also equipped with laser links for line-of-sight communication or in case of radio interference.

Source: Eclipse Phase Gatecrashing, p. 163.
